item.soulwarden.spell_book/shepherd.spel:
Be a shepherd of souls
- Summon Spirits and Ancestors to fight for you
- Decent survivability due to armor and minions, damage can scale under ideal circumstances.
spell.soulwarden.spirit_bolts.name: Spirit Bolts
spell.soulwarden.spirit_bolts.descriptio: Shoot unpredictable wisps of spirit energy in a direction for {damage} Soul DPS. On killing an enemy with this spell, or with a 10%% chance on hit, a Soul Fragment is dropped.
spell.soulwarden.bind.name: Bind
spell.soulwarden.bind.description: Bind the nearest Soul Fragment to your servitude, manifesting as a zombie minion that fights for you for a duration. Minion health and damage scale with Soul Power (+12.5%% per 1 Soul Power).
spell.soulwarden.guide.name: Guide
spell.soulwarden.guide.description: Guide the nearest Soul Fragment to the afterlife, granting you 1 stack of Soul Power, up to 10.
spell.soulwarden.pilgrimage.name: Exodus
spell.soulwarden.pilgrimage.description: Guide all nearby Soul Fragments to the afterlife, providing Regeneration 5 and Exodus (100%% increased Soul Power) for a three seconds per soul.
spell.soulwarden.pain_attunement.name: Pain Attunement
spell.soulwarden.pain_attunement.descrip: Deal 5 magic damage yourself to drop a soul fragment at your feet.
spell.soulwarden.ancestral_guardian.name: Ancestral Guardian
spell.soulwarden.ancestral_guardian.desc: Summon an Ancestral Guardian to protect you. This minion's health and damage scales with Soul Power (+12.5%% per 1 Soul Power)
spell.soulwarden.ancestral_totem.name: Ancestral Totem
spell.soulwarden.ancestral_totem.descrip: Summon forth an ancestral totem that emits a shockwave every three seconds, dealing physical damage in an area based on your melee weapon. Health and Duration is based on your Soul Power.
